body.name: Validated Hessian range oracle
body.construction: Fix \(\mathcal O_n\) as an outward-rounded interval implementation of the finite wavelet, kernel, numerical Monge--Ampere, and deterministic spectral-clipping representation of \(\widehat H_p\). It encloses the clipped field on rational boxes and its excess diameter vanishes under subdivision. On \(\mathcal B_n\), clipping is inactive, so enlarging its intervals by \([-r_{H,n},r_{H,n}]\) entrywise encloses \(H_p\).
